name: address_decision
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

gate.description: WAIT gate payload carrying the human's reply-approval decision; shape is normalized regardless of which fields are populated.

action.description: Explicit requested action from the gate payload.

approved.description: Legacy approval flag; treated as action=approve when action is absent and this is true.

feedback.description: Reviewer feedback/rationale; must be non-blank for a 'revise' action to take effect.

body.description: Reply body override supplied directly on the gate.

artifact.description: Fallback container for the reply body.

body.description: Fallback reply body, used when gate.body is absent.

fallbackBody.description: Reply body used when neither gate.body nor gate.artifact.body is set.

action.description: Resolved gate action after validating approval/feedback requirements.

feedback.description: Reviewer feedback text (empty string when none was supplied).

body.description: Resolved reply body, preferring gate.body, then gate.artifact.body, then fallbackBody.
